annotations.title: Request a timing check (is now the right moment?)

description: Request a human judgment on whether now is the right moment to send, call, follow up, post or ask – considering culture, context and etiquette. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 9 per question. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

options.description: Optional: the time options you are considering.

planned_action.description: What you plan to do, e.g. send a payment reminder.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
